headline: Executive order changes federal rules on protecting US ships, harbors, ports, and waterfront facilities.
what_it_does: This executive order amends existing federal regulations on safeguarding vessels, harbors, ports, and waterfront facilities in the United States. The title does not say which rules change or how. No summary was provided, so the specific new requirements or powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Owners and operators of ships in US waters
who_it_affects.how: They may face changed federal rules on how their vessels are protected and secured.
They may face changed federal security rules for their harbors, ports, and facilities.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 21, 2024; the provided material does not state a separate effective date.
